title: Fault-Tolerant Budget Conservation in Distributed Multi-Agent Delegation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00349v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Resource limits are becoming an authorization boundary for AI agents that delegate work across concurrent and failure-prone workers. Parent-child allocation constraints, affine objects, and distributed escrow do not by themselves prevent overspend when replies are lost, effects complete after timeout, messages repeat, branches partition, or DAG joins alias one lineage. We formalize fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation. Budgets are quantized resource vectors represented by exclusive escrow credits that move through a delegation DAG. Before dispatch, a branch converts credit into an operation reservation bound to lineage, epoch, normalized effect, maximum charge, receiver, and idempotency key. It persists a signed dispatch permit with quarantine; the gateway verifies that permit before first acceptance. translated_title: 分布式多智能体委托中的容错预算守恒
translated_abstract: 资源限制正在成为AI智能体在并发且易故障的工作者之间委派任务时的一种授权边界。当回复丢失、效果在超时后才完成、消息重复、分支发生网络分区、或DAG汇入节点对同一条血统产生别名时，父子分配约束、仿射对象和分布式托管机制本身并不能防止预算超支。本文对分布式多智能体委托中的容错预算守恒问题进行了形式化。预算被表示为量化的资源向量，由通过委托DAG流动的独占托管信用来体现。在分发之前，分支将信用转换为一种操作预留，该预留绑定血统、纪元、规范化效果、最大费用、接收者和幂等键。系统持久化一个带有隔离机制的签名分发许可；网关在首次接受请求之前会验证该许可。不确定的效果将保持计费状态，直到完成经认证的结算，或收到带围栏控制的权威无效果裁决……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文形式化了分布式多智能体委托场景下的容错预算守恒问题，提出通过独占托管信用、绑定血统与幂等键的操作预留、签名分发许可和认证结算等机制，在消息丢失、重复、超时和网络分区等故障条件下防止AI智能体预算超支。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes fault-tolerant budget conservation in distributed multi-agent delegation, proposing exclusive escrow credits, lineage- and idempotency-bound operation reservations, signed dispatch permits, and authenticated settlement to prevent budget overspending under message loss, duplication, timeouts, and network partitions.
